items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Oh, True was with Chick's band! ... I think Amos(?) was in that band...I think... You know, because everybody was giggin' with whoever you could.

ctx.x: Oh, let me see, who was in the band. Amos Truehart, Bobby Starks, what's the name, Slats...trombone player -- yeah, I remember that; it might have been Slats with the brass section. Elmer Williams was the tenor player -- Elmer and Johnny. He just had a small band. And I know the bass player, Leon England... No. It was Leon something, but it wasn't Leon England, because Leon England was the Boss Man.
But yeah, I met all the band. I remember practically
